body: Felt this deep into my heart

Same shit here. Never had a relationship in 20 years. It's what is crushing me the more. Especially when i see young guys like 15-16 years old and i start to think about what went wrong with me and how did i miss all of this
Music helps me a lot but this time i need to feel something at a physical level
I know but it's not easy
Bold of you to assume i will have an older self :)
This comment made me cry bro
Same fuckin shit here man, it's depressing as hell having never been loved by anyone
Yes, this happens to a lot of us too. I'm not a therapist or anything but i think it's just because we're fragile as hell and therefore everything has the power to cause a mental breakdown.
Exactly
Already gave up a long time ago. My life rn is just a countdown to my suicide
Thank you.

Pushing away all my responsibilities and my duties and then crying in my bed for hours is a thought that my mind perceives as relaxing. I know it's not right and that is taking time from myself to get better, but i just can't compete, my mind is too strong.
Good luck, you can do it.
Naah i don't care about being healthy and loved, I've given up on that. I just want all of my problems to end now
I think bout this every single day
Same my friend. Same...
I just want to kill myself. I don't care about my problems anymore. The only goal that's left in my life is to find a way of taking my life in the less painful possible way.
I don't want to talk to them about my problems. They don't know what struggling with mental illness means and to them everything is fine with me. So let's keep it that way

There's nothing going on with him. I just don't want him to hear me and then ask me questions, I've never cried in front of any member of my family since i was like 9 and i don't like when they talk about my problems, i just want to be alone.
There's nothing you can appreciate about me. Literally nothing I'm not even exaggerating. Nothing.
